title: Exaggeration
summary: EXAGGERA'TION, noun A heaping together; heap; accumulation. 1. In rhetoric, amplification; a representation of things beyond the truth; hyperbolical representation, whether of good or evil. 2. In pain

inlines.v: EXAGGERA'TION, noun A heaping together; heap; accumulation. 1. In rhetoric, amplification; a representation of things beyond the truth; hyperbolical representation, whether of good or evil. 2. In painting, a method of giving a representation of things too strong for the life.
